svg.aria-label: How the film is made. The top race draws at 64 pixels, the size the policy flies from, and chooses each action. The bottom race draws at 256 pixels and takes the same action at every step, both races started from the same seed. While an episode runs uninterrupted the film shows that episode; a drone whose episode ends is restarted on the deciding side only, which would break the match.
